scope: December 2020 domestic public gatherings and continuity from September 2020 into January 2021
known_limit: Nine managed web queries included weekly December windows, English and Tigrinya, official MOI and diaspora outlets, and a January 2021 continuity query. Search results were noisy and did not identify a specific domestic protest candidate. Two official MOI pages were assessed and opened. Part I concerned January-April and was out of scope; Part III reviewed September-December but was an official year-in-review narrative and did not report a qualifying protest. Omission from this source does not demonstrate absence. Independent reporting and regional/sector coverage remain thin.
next_steps: Locate independent contemporaneous reports and issue-level sources; query Asmara, Keren, Massawa, Assab, Barentu, Mendefera and other regions across workers, students, women, retirees, religious and national-service sectors; check Sep/Jan boundaries for documented campaign onset/continuity without merging separate recurring rallies.
